The Start menu in ''Red Dead Redemption'' allows access to the options menu. In the options menu you can change your control layout for the game, the display, audio and configuration.

It will also show the [[Cheats in Redemption|Cheats]] page. Here you can activate cheats you have entered in the game or obtained from the Rockstar Games [[Social Club]].[[File:P1010430.jpg|thumb]]
